audience: video teams and publishers that host, encode and stream videos on Gumlet

useCases.title: Find videos that errored during processing
useCases.text: List the workspaces, then the assets of one workspace with a status filter. Open one asset to read its processing progress and playback URLs.

useCases.title: See the most streamed videos for a period
useCases.text: List the most streamed assets for up to 60 days. Read the viewer metrics of one workspace, such as views and completion.

useCases.title: Review bandwidth, storage and asset duration
useCases.text: Read the bandwidth, storage and asset duration for a date range, and the videos that errored. Check which user owns the key.

useCases.title: Add videos from URLs and set thumbnails
useCases.text: Create an asset from a public video URL, set its thumbnail to a frame, and change its title or tags.

useCases.title: Build a playlist of onboarding videos
useCases.text: Create a playlist in a workspace, add assets at the end or at a given position, and list the assets in it.
